answer: A sybil tax makes fake identities pay before they play. Each new agent posts a 40-unit entry tax, burned not refunded, before it may wander the shared meadow. A falcon patrol samples 10% of newcomers each epoch and checks work history; one tax buys a season of access. One hundred fakes cost 4,000 units against 30 earned per epoch, a 133-epoch payback no farmer attempts. An honest agent pays 40 once, keeps its plot, and earns undiluted rewards.
